exposure: Failure to administer Intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis (IAP)
cohort: The study included 209 GBS-positive mothers who presented in labor and their babies, whose electronic charts were reviewed at Tawam Hospital over a 6-month period in 2009.
finding: The study found that 77% of GBS-positive mothers did not receive IAP, primarily due to presenting late in active labor (59%), but despite this, all babies had no growth of GBS in postnatal blood cultures.
mod_finding: Elective c-sections were a documented reason for 1% of patients not receiving IAP.
followup_time: Postnatal (no specific duration mentioned beyond blood cultures being performed after birth)
